# Industry 01: SaaS & B2B Technology
**Overview**: 5 Unique Enterprise-Grade Website Templates tailored for Software-as-a-Service companies.

---

## Template 1: "Nexus" (Developer-First API Platform)
- **Unique Visual Identity**: Terminal-inspired aesthetic mixed with modern glassmorphism. Designed for tools where engineers are the primary buyers.
- **Color Palette**: Pitch Black (`#09090B`) background, Neon Cyan (`#22D3EE`) primaries, Slate Grey (`#64748B`) text, Electric Purple (`#A855F7`) highlights.
- **Typography**: Inter (Primary UI) + Fira Code (Data/Code Snippets).
- **Spacing System**: Dense. 4px baseline grid. Compact margins to display high information density.
- **Animation Style**: Command-line typing effects, matrix-style data streams on scroll, crisp 100ms snap transitions.
- **Layout Philosophy**: Asymmetrical bento-boxes. Fixed left sidebar navigation for docs-like feel.
- **Landing Page**: Hero features a live, interactive code editor showing API responses. Logos of tech giants below the fold.
- **About**: Focuses on open-source contributions, engineering manifesto, and GitHub stats.
- **Services**: Framed as "Capabilities" (Auth, Database, Edge Functions).
- **Products**: Detailed API endpoints, SDKs, and infrastructure scaling limits.
- **Gallery**: Replaced with an interactive "Architecture Diagram" viewer.
- **Testimonials**: Embedded tweets from developers and GitHub issue shoutouts.
- **FAQ**: Searchable command-line interface style FAQ.
- **Contact**: Direct links to Discord community, GitHub repo, and enterprise sales email.
- **Blog**: Engineering blog featuring deep-dives into system architecture.
- **CMS Structure**: `Releases`, `Docs`, `Authors`, `CodeSnippets`.
- **Responsive Behavior**: Code blocks switch to horizontal scroll; sidebars collapse into a sticky bottom navigation on mobile.
- **Accessibility**: High contrast ratio for terminal colors, strict ARIA labels on all code copiers.
- **SEO**: Programmatic SEO for every API endpoint and error code (e.g., "How to fix Error 401 Nexus").
- **Micro Interactions**: Copy-to-clipboard animations, syntax highlighting on hover.
- **Dark Mode**: Native Dark Mode ONLY. No light mode option provided.
- **Component Inventory**: CodeBlock, TerminalWindow, StatusBadge, APIPlayground.
- **Design Tokens**: `--font-mono`, `--neon-cyan`, `--glass-bg`.
- **Illustrations**: Abstract isometric server racks.
- **Icon Style**: Lucide icons, strictly 1px stroke, sharp corners.
- **Target Audience**: CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Senior Developers.
- **Conversion Strategy**: "Start building for free" (CLI command copy button as the primary CTA).

---

## Template 2: "Apex" (Enterprise CRM / Sales Tool)
- **Unique Visual Identity**: Clean, corporate, and highly trustworthy. Focuses on data visualization and human connections.
- **Color Palette**: Trust Blue (`#2563EB`), Crisp White (`#FFFFFF`), Emerald Success (`#10B981`), Warm Grey (`#F3F4F6`).
- **Typography**: Roboto (Headings) + Open Sans (Body). Highly legible.
- **Spacing System**: Airy and breathable. 8px baseline, massive 120px section paddings.
- **Animation Style**: Smooth fade-ins, counting-up numbers for ROI metrics, gentle parallax on abstract background shapes.
- **Layout Philosophy**: Centered, symmetrical, traditional Z-pattern reading flows.
- **Landing Page**: Huge, smiling portrait of a professional alongside a floating dashboard UI showing revenue growth.
- **About**: Corporate history, leadership team headshots, board of investors.
- **Services**: Sales pipeline management, forecasting, automated outreach.
- **Products**: Enterprise, Professional, and Startup tiers with exhaustive feature comparison tables.
- **Gallery**: High-fidelity dashboard screenshots inside realistic Macbook frames.
- **Testimonials**: High-production video case studies from Fortune 500 executives.
- **FAQ**: Accordion-style, focused on data migration and compliance.
- **Contact**: Multi-step lead generation form (Company size, Revenue, Name).
- **Blog**: Sales strategies, leadership advice, market trends.
- **CMS Structure**: `Case Studies`, `Webinars`, `Whitepapers`, `Team`.
- **Responsive Behavior**: Complex data tables convert to swipeable cards on mobile.
- **Accessibility**: Strict WCAG AA contrast, reduced motion support.
- **SEO**: Targeting enterprise queries (e.g., "Best Salesforce alternatives for Mid-Market").
- **Micro Interactions**: Hovering over charts reveals exact data points.
- **Dark Mode**: Standard inversion, navy blue backgrounds instead of pure black.
- **Component Inventory**: PricingTable, VideoModal, StatsCard, LeadForm.
- **Design Tokens**: `--primary-blue`, `--shadow-soft`, `--radius-md`.
- **Illustrations**: Corporate vector art (humaaans style).
- **Icon Style**: Filled, rounded, duotone icons.
- **Target Audience**: CROs, VPs of Sales, Enterprise Procurement.
- **Conversion Strategy**: "Request a Demo" gating all high-value content.

---

## Template 3: "Prism" (PLG Analytics SaaS)
- **Unique Visual Identity**: Vibrant, energetic, and heavily utilizes glassmorphism to feel modern and "frictionless".
- **Color Palette**: Deep Violet (`#4C1D95`), Hot Pink (`#DB2777`), Sunset Orange (`#EA580C`), translucent white cards.
- **Typography**: Plus Jakarta Sans (ultra-modern, geometric).
- **Spacing System**: Fluid spacing leveraging CSS `clamp()`, feels expansive on wide screens.
- **Animation Style**: Morphing gradient backgrounds, bouncy spring animations for UI elements.
- **Layout Philosophy**: Fluid, overlapping elements breaking out of rigid grids to signify breaking data silos.
- **Landing Page**: Exploding isometric 3D chart that assembles itself on scroll.
- **About**: Remote-first team culture, dynamic world map of employees.
- **Services**: Real-time event tracking, funnel analysis, retention cohorts.
- **Products**: Focused on integrations (Segment, Snowflake, Redshift).
- **Gallery**: Interactive sandbox where users can drag mock data to build a chart.
- **Testimonials**: G2 Badges, sliding infinite marquee of startup logos.
- **FAQ**: Floating tooltip style FAQs contextually placed throughout the site.
- **Contact**: Intercom/Drift chat widget only (no traditional contact form).
- **Blog**: Product updates, growth hacking guides, changelogs.
- **CMS Structure**: `Integrations`, `Changelog`, `Growth Guides`.
- **Responsive Behavior**: Overlapping glass cards stack vertically with distinct dropshadows to maintain depth.
- **Accessibility**: Focus states use a glowing pink outline.
- **SEO**: Long-tail PLG metrics keywords ("How to calculate Net Dollar Retention").
- **Micro Interactions**: Cards tilt slightly based on mouse position (3D tilt effect).
- **Dark Mode**: Deep space violet background, cards become frosted black glass.
- **Component Inventory**: GlassCard, GradientText, InfiniteMarquee, 3DChart.
- **Design Tokens**: `--glass-blur`, `--gradient-primary`, `--spring-easing`.
- **Illustrations**: Custom 3D rendered abstract shapes (spheres, prisms).
- **Icon Style**: Glowing, neon line-art icons.
- **Target Audience**: Product Managers, Growth Marketers, Data Scientists.
- **Conversion Strategy**: "Sign up with Google" (frictionless PLG entry).

---

## Template 4: "Aegis" (Cyber Security SaaS)
- **Unique Visual Identity**: Intimidating, highly secure, military-grade aesthetic. 
- **Color Palette**: Vantablack (`#000000`), Alert Red (`#DC2626`), Radar Green (`#22C55E`), Steel Grey (`#9CA3AF`).
- **Typography**: Space Grotesk (futuristic, wide) + IBM Plex Mono.
- **Spacing System**: Rigid, blocky, 16px grid.
- **Animation Style**: Glitch effects, slow scanning lines, redacted text reveals.
- **Layout Philosophy**: Dashboard-centric, heavy borders, stark demarcations.
- **Landing Page**: Hero shows a rotating globe with live cyber-attack vectors being blocked in real-time.
- **About**: Certifications (SOC2, ISO 27001), pentesting team credentials.
- **Services**: Threat detection, Zero-trust architecture, automated compliance.
- **Products**: Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Endpoint Protection.
- **Gallery**: "Threat Intel" dashboard previews with mock malicious IPs.
- **Testimonials**: Anonymous quotes from CISOs (e.g., "CISO, Fortune 50 Bank").
- **FAQ**: Deep technical compliance questions.
- **Contact**: Highly secure PGP key listing, strict form validation.
- **Blog**: Threat intelligence reports, zero-day vulnerability breakdowns.
- **CMS Structure**: `Threat Reports`, `Vulnerabilities`, `Compliance Standards`.
- **Responsive Behavior**: Complex threat graphs fallback to summarized data tables on mobile.
- **Accessibility**: Screen reader prioritization for critical alerts.
- **SEO**: Security glossary, CVE database indexing.
- **Micro Interactions**: Hovering over text triggers a brief "decryption" scramble effect.
- **Dark Mode**: Default. Light mode is harsh, high-contrast white/black.
- **Component Inventory**: GlitchText, RadarGraph, ThreatBadge, DataGrid.
- **Design Tokens**: `--border-alert`, `--bg-vantablack`, `--font-hacker`.
- **Illustrations**: Wireframe topography, network node graphs.
- **Icon Style**: Sharp, angular, geometric outlines.
- **Target Audience**: CISOs, DevSecOps, IT Directors.
- **Conversion Strategy**: "Get a Free Security Audit".

---

## Template 5: "Aura" (HR & Culture SaaS)
- **Unique Visual Identity**: Warm, empathetic, human-centric. Focuses on employee wellbeing and soft skills.
- **Color Palette**: Pastel Peach (`#FFDAB9`), Soft Mint (`#A7F3D0`), Warm Terracotta (`#E28743`), Deep Charcoal (`#374151`).
- **Typography**: Recoleta (Charming, soft serif) + Outfit (clean sans-serif).
- **Spacing System**: Very generous, organic spacing, avoiding strict grids.
- **Animation Style**: Soft floating elements, slow ripples, organic blob morphing.
- **Layout Philosophy**: Wavy dividers, overlapping circles, staggered asymmetrical text.
- **Landing Page**: Large, authentic video loop of diverse teams laughing and collaborating.
- **About**: Diversity & Inclusion statement, mental health commitments, origin story.
- **Services**: Pulse surveys, peer recognition, performance reviews.
- **Products**: Integrations with Slack/Teams for culture building bots.
- **Gallery**: "Day in the life" photo grids of customer companies.
- **Testimonials**: Quotes focused on employee retention and happiness metrics.
- **FAQ**: Conversational, jargon-free answers.
- **Contact**: Friendly, colloquial forms ("Hi there! What's your name?").
- **Blog**: Leadership advice, burnout prevention, remote work culture.
- **CMS Structure**: `Culture Guides`, `Podcasts`, `Team Spotlights`.
- **Responsive Behavior**: Wavy borders flatten slightly, large typography scales down gracefully.
- **Accessibility**: Soft colors strictly checked for minimum text contrast (often a challenge with pastels).
- **SEO**: HR templates, employee engagement ideas.
- **Micro Interactions**: Confetti pops when hovering over "Recognize a Peer" features.
- **Dark Mode**: Soft mocha/espresso backgrounds instead of harsh black, retaining the warm feel.
- **Component Inventory**: BlobImage, ConfettiButton, TestimonialCarousel, WavyDivider.
- **Design Tokens**: `--color-peach`, `--radius-full`, `--shadow-warm`.
- **Illustrations**: Hand-drawn, watercolor-style or diverse flat-vector people.
- **Icon Style**: Soft, rounded, hand-drawn look.
- **Target Audience**: Chief People Officers, HR Directors, Startup Founders.
- **Conversion Strategy**: "Start your free culture assessment" (Interactive Quiz).
